title: Business Analysis Intern
headline: Business Analysis Intern @ Thoughtworks
key_points: About Thoughtworks & The Strategic Beach Management Portfolio Thoughtworks is a leading global technology consultancy that integrates strategy, design, and software engineering to drive digital innovation.

In professional services and IT consulting firms like Thoughtworks, the "beach" (or "bench") refers to the pool of talented consultants who are temporarily unassigned between billable client engagements.

Rather than treating this period as idle time, proactive beach management transforms transient capacity into a strategic asset and ensures consultants remain deployable and ready to meet rapid commercial demand.
